observation.command: cd /workspace && docker run --rm daz-pilot-backup:latest age-keygen 2>/dev/null > age-identity.txt && cat age-identity.txt && AGE_RECIPIENT=$(grep -o 'age1[a-z0-9]*' age-identity.txt | head -1) && echo "RECIPIENT=$AGE_RECIPIENT" && sed -i "s|^AGE_RECIPIENT=.*|AGE_RECIPIENT=${AGE_RECIPIENT}|" .env && grep -n "^AGE_RECIPIENT=" .env && chmod 600 age-identity.txt && mv age-identity.txt /tmp/age-identity.txt
